name: ordinary-day
about: Two campaigns with leads, a month's spend and two mature cohorts beside a young one.

output.headline: 2 campaigns ran on November 3, 2026, spending $284.25 across 14,600 impressions and 203 clicks to bring in 7 leads at a $40.61 cost per lead.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet drove most of the day's volume: $184.50 spent, 9,120 impressions, 141 clicks at a 1.5% click rate, 6 leads at $30.75 each. Dedicated night runs added 1 lead at $99.75 on $99.75 spent, 5,480 impressions, 62 clicks, and a 1.1% click rate.
November 2026 is 28 days in with $612.30 spent on Meta so far.
The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads, mature) shows 36 contacted, 20 converted, 12 applied, 5 hired, and 9 lost after conversion — the strongest hire rate of the mature cohorts at 12.5%.
The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads, mature) has 33 contacted, 17 converted, 10 applied, 4 hired, and 8 lost after conversion — a 10.5% hire rate and 44.7% conversion rate.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads and is too young to judge: 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, none hired so far, with leads still moving.
No lead quality data was available for the 14-day window — the campaign list came back empty.
